items.title: POLICY: GEOPOLITICAL TETRIS
items.description:
Illustration by Sarah Durrani
    
Tetris is an interestingly simple but challenging game. Blocks of different shapes descend on to a confined board and the player must continuously find space to accommodate them. Every placement affects the next move. As the board fills, choices diminish, mistakes become increasingly expensive, and even the right piece arriving at the wrong time can become a problem.
